phase_name: TAMPC-001 Signature Ambiguity Contract Repair Independent Verification
summary: Independent verification phase treating TAMPC-001 v1.1 and the Phase 137M repair as untrusted. Independently reproduced Finding F-1's original ambiguity by calling the live inspect_artifact_at_path function with the literal frozen v1.0 two-parameter form (TypeError confirmed fresh, not copied from 137L/137M transcripts). Independently confirmed TAMPC-001 v1.1 Section 5/5.1 admits exactly one interpretation of the signature, with no competing reading found in adjacent sections. Independently derived the canonical signature via live inspect.signature() introspection (not textual comparison) and confirmed it is identical to TAMPC-REQ-023 v1.1's frozen text and to the CLI call site. Independently confirmed Compatibility Review Outcome A via git show 73e6823f --stat (zero files under src/ or tests/ in the 137M commit) and via a fresh 100/100 pass of tests/test_authority_inspect_137k.py and tests/test_typed_authority_inspector_137e.py. Independently re-counted requirement identifiers with a stricter, colon-anchored, sequential-completeness method (182 unique, 1-182, no gaps or duplicates) than 137M's own looser grep method. Ran a broader authority-relevant regression sweep than 137M reused from 137L (-k authority vs -k cltr_authority_136), surfacing one additional pre-existing, independently-confirmed-unrelated test failure. See docs/PHASE_137MV_TAMPC_SIGNATURE_AMBIGUITY_CONTRACT_REPAIR_INDEPENDENT_VERIFICATION.md.
tests_added_or_updated: None. This is an independent verification phase; no implementation or test file was modified. Existing suites were re-run fresh as independent evidence, not copied from prior phases' transcripts.

validation_results.fast_green: .venv/bin/python -m pytest -m fast_green -n auto -q: 4391 passed, identical to Phase 137L's own baseline -- confirms no regression.
validation_results.broader_authority_sweep: .venv/bin/python -m pytest -k authority -q: 16 failed, 3568 passed, 3 skipped, 21846 deselected -- 15 of 16 failures independently confirmed inherited/pre-existing (matching Phase 137L's own classification); 1 additional failure (test_cltr_135o_integration.py::TestEnabledStage1::test_legacy_authority_still_completed_transaction) newly surfaced by this phase's broader filter, independently confirmed unrelated to TAMPC-001 and pre-existing (Phase 137M's own commit touched zero src/tests files) -- recorded as Finding F-5, Deferred, logged in tasks/TODO.md Known Issues.
validation_results.requirement_count_independent_recount: grep -oE '^TAMPC-REQ-[0-9]+:' docs/contracts/TYPED_AUTHORITY_MODEL_PRODUCTION_CONSUMPTION_CONTRACT.md | sed 's/://' | sort -u | wc -l: 182, cross-checked for sequential completeness (1-182, no gaps, no duplicates) via an independent script -- stricter method than Phase 137M's own '^TAMPC-REQ-' grep, same numeric result.
validation_results.live_signature_introspection: .venv/bin/python -c "import inspect; from pcae.cltr.authority_inspection import inspect_artifact_at_path; print(inspect.signature(inspect_artifact_at_path))": (path: Path, *, artifact_bytes: bytes, json_output: bool = False) -> InspectionOutcome -- identical to TAMPC-REQ-023 v1.1.
validation_results.ambiguity_reproduction: Calling inspect_artifact_at_path(Path('x'), json_output=True) (the literal frozen v1.0 two-parameter form) freshly raises TypeError: missing 1 required keyword-only argument: 'artifact_bytes' -- independently reproduces Finding F-1's original defect.
